cohort: The study included 233 NICU patients less than 3 months of age who received hydrocortisone for hypotension.
finding: Gastrointestinal bleeding occurred in 9.4% of patients, and stress ulcer prophylaxis did not provide benefit for GIB prevention nor was it associated with increased risk of adverse effects.
gest_age: Median postmenstrual age at hydrocortisone initiation was 33.3 weeks
